methods.name: catalog
methods.doc: Read the complete process-level catalog exposed to current-session UI.

props.name: options
props.doc: Every currently selectable preset, in contribution order.

props.name: defaultOptions
props.doc: Configured presets eligible as defaults for future sessions.

props.name: defaultPreset
props.doc: Effective default when the Config field is omitted.

PermissionCatalog.doc: Process-level permission catalog. It changes with live contributions and is deliberately separate from Session history.

props.name: value
props.doc: Stable option value: a configured preset key, live `auto`, or derived `custom`.

props.name: description
props.doc: One user-facing sentence on what the value means; omitted when not configured.

PresetOption.doc: Presentation for an available preset or the derived `custom` current value.
